import sys

def main():
    data = list(map(int, sys.stdin.read().split()))
    if not data:
        return

    n = data[0]
    a = data[1:1 + n]

    ones = [i for i, x in enumerate(a) if x == 1]

    ans = 0
    m = len(ones)

    for idx, pos in enumerate(ones):
        prev = ones[idx - 1] if idx > 0 else -1
        nxt = ones[idx + 1] if idx + 1 < m else n

        left_choices = pos - prev
        right_choices = nxt - pos

        ans += left_choices * right_choices

    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
